nodes.label: Handoffs Multi-Agent Module
nodes.rationale: Implements the multiple agent subgraphs handoffs pattern — distinct sales and support agents exist as separate nodes in a StateGraph, with handoff tools navigating via active_agent state.

nodes.label: returnDirect=true Pattern
nodes.rationale: Handoff tools use returnDirect=true so the agent exits immediately after the tool call — no model response is generated — and the parent graph's conditional edge then routes to the target agent.

nodes.label: ToolContextHelper.getStateForUpdate
nodes.rationale: Tools use ToolContextHelper.getStateForUpdate(toolContext) to set active_agent; the update is merged into the graph state when the agent node completes, enabling seamless handoff routing.

nodes.label: Full Message History Context
nodes.rationale: The full message history flows to the next agent for context preservation; for production, consider summarizing or filtering context for token efficiency.

nodes.label: Studio Agent Auto-Discovery
nodes.rationale: The two agents (sales_agent, support_agent) are Spring beans; Studio discovers them automatically via context scanning, eliminating the need for a custom AgentLoader.
